'''Tane''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as an [[Ensign/Legends|ensign]] in the [[Republic Army]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Stationed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Taris/Legends|Taris]], Tane was among a number of [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] who were captured by the [[Death's Claw]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] group and imprisoned in [[Fallenspire Stronghold]], but were freed by [[Havoc Squad]]. Tane's information helped Havoc Squad track down the traitor [[Ryler Dorant]].
